slot.brief: Circular coil with given turns, current and area (or radius); compute the magnetic dipole moment NIA.

stem: A circular coil has $50$ turns, area $4.0\times10^{-3}$ m$^2$ per turn and carries a current of $2$ A. What is its magnetic dipole moment?
working:
$\mu=NIA=50\times2\times4.0\times10^{-3}=0.40\ \text{A m}^2$

Independent check: Magnetic dipole moment: \(\mu=NIA=50(2)(4.0\times10^{-3})=0.40\ \text{A m}^2\).
